_meta.why: Known-debt baseline for the D812 enum control-shape gate. These are 2-5-option enums whose RENDERED LABEL (not slug) is <=12 chars but which currently render as SelectControl instead of ToggleGroupControl. Ratchet: --check fails on any NEW violation, never on these. NOT a fix-immediately list -- see decisions.md D812 + this branch's session notes for why the gate's own count (45) differs from D812's slug-derived estimate (85).
_meta.design_exempt_note: Entries carrying a 'reason' field are NOT debt -- they are correctly-resolved D812 violations that conflict with a separate, more specific Bean-locked rule and are baselined permanently, not pending conversion. quote.attributionFontStyle: its real control lives in the shared TypographyControls component (prefix='attribution', showStyle), whose font-style row is explicitly SelectControl per CLAUDE.md's Bean-locked R-22-13 ('weight + style = SelectControl dropdowns') -- converting it to ToggleGroupControl would violate that rule, which governs every TypographyControls adopter, not just this one block.
_meta.dispositionVocabularyNote: Closed vocabulary: by-design (correct, will never need fixing) / accepted-debt (real gap, consciously deferred) / detector-limitation (the checker itself is wrong — flags a rule violation per THE-MIGRATION-METHOD.md:455, not a normal outcome) / blocked (waiting on something external). See .claude/parking.md P-BASELINE-DISPOSITION-VOCABULARY / .claude/LEDGER.md.
